/* Matching Stock Recovery Analyzer's established TiedChain design */
:root{--blue:#2563eb;--ink:#0f172a;--muted:#475569;--line:#e2e8f0;--soft:#f7faff}
body{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#f8fbff 36%,#fff 100%);color:#0f172a;line-height:1.6}
.site-header{max-width:1160px;margin:24px auto 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.06);padding:12px 22px}
.header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}
.official-logo{display:block;width:178px;max-width:40vw;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.back{font-size:14px;color:#2563eb;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
.back:hover{text-decoration:underline}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#0f172a}
h1{font-size:clamp(35px,4.5vw,57px)}h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,27px)}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(15,23,42,.065);padding:24px;margin-top:22px}
.metric{background:#f7faff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:17px;color:#475569}
.metric b{color:#0f172a;font-family:Manrope,Inter,sans-serif}
button{background:#2563eb;color:white;border:1px solid #2563eb;border-radius:13px;padding:12px 20px;box-shadow:0 9px 20px rgba(37,99,235,.14);font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
button:hover{background:#1747b4;color:white;transform:translateY(-2px)}
button.secondary{background:#fff;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;box-shadow:none}
button.secondary:hover{background:#f8fafc;color:#2563eb}
input[type=file],select{background:#fff;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px}
th{color:#334155;background:#f8fafc}th,td{border-bottom-color:#e2e8f0}
footer{color:#64748b;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;margin-top:25px;padding-top:18px}
@media(max-width:650px){.site-header{margin:12px 12px 0;padding:12px}.official-logo{width:145px}.card{padding:16px}.back{font-size:12px}}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}table{min-width:720px}th,td{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;padding:12px 14px}th{color:#0f172a}td{color:#334155}.hint{line-height:1.65}summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2563eb;outline-offset:4px}

'use strict';const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);for(let i=1;i<=12;i++)$('horizon').add(new Option(i+' month'+(i===1?'':'s'),i));$('horizon').value='6';let output=[];const METHODS=['Moving Average','Holt','Holt-Winters','Linear Regression','Linear Regression + Seasonality'];const avg=a=>a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length;const valid=a=>a.every(Number.isFinite);const clamp=x=>Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(x)?x:0);function regression(y,degree,h){let n=y.length,k=degree+1;if(n<k+2)return null;let mat=Array.from({length:k},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:k+1},(_,j)=>j===k?y.reduce((s,v,t)=>s+v*Math.pow(t+1,i),0):y.reduce((s,_,t)=>s+Math.pow(t+1,i+j),0)));for(let i=0;i<k;i++){let p=i;for(let r=i+1;r<k;r++)if(Math.abs(mat[r][i])>Math.abs(mat[p][i]))p=r;if(Math.abs(mat[p][i])<1e-9)return null;[mat[i],mat[p]]=[mat[p],mat[i]];let d=mat[i][i];for(let c=i;c<=k;c++)mat[i][c]/=d;for(let r=0;r<k;r++)if(r!==i){let f=mat[r][i];for(let c=i;c<=k;c++)mat[r][c]-=f*mat[i][c]}}let b=mat.map(r=>r[k]);return Array.from({length:h},(_,j)=>b.reduce((s,v,i)=>s+v*Math.pow(n+j+1,i),0))}function indices(y,degree){if(y.length<24)return null;let tr=regression(y,degree,y.length);if(!tr)return null;let coeff=[];let n=y.length,k=degree+1;let x=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i+1);let A=Array.from({length:k},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:k+1},(_,j)=>j===k?y.reduce((s,v,t)=>s+v*Math.pow(x[t],i),0):y.reduce((s,_,t)=>s+Math.pow(x[t],i+j),0)));for(let i=0;i<k;i++){let p=i;for(let r=i+1;r<k;r++)if(Math.abs(A[r][i])>Math.abs(A[p][i]))p=r;if(Math.abs(A[p][i])<1e-9)return null;[A[i],A[p]]=[A[p],A[i]];let d=A[i][i];for(let c=i;c<=k;c++)A[i][c]/=d;for(let r=0;r<k;r++)if(r!==i){let f=A[r][i];for(let c=i;c<=k;c++)A[r][c]-=f*A[i][c]}}coeff=A.map(r=>r[k]);let buckets=Array.from({length:12},()=>[]);y.forEach((v,i)=>{let trend=coeff.reduce((s,b,d)=>s+b*Math.pow(i+1,d),0);if(trend>1e-6)buckets[i%12].push(v/trend)});if(buckets.some(b=>!b.length))return null;let raw=buckets.map(avg),m=avg(raw);return m>0?raw.map(v=>v/m):null}
function forecast(y,method,h){let n=y.length;if(n<2||!valid(y))return null;let out=null;if(method==='Naïve')out=Array(h).fill(y[n-1]);if(method==='Moving Average')out=Array(h).fill(avg(y.slice(-Math.min(3,n))));if(method==='Weighted Moving Average'){let a=y.slice(-Math.min(3,n)),w=a.map((_,i)=>i+1);out=Array(h).fill(a.reduce((s,v,i)=>s+v*w[i],0)/w.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0))}if(method==='Exponential Smoothing'){let l=y[0];for(let i=1;i<n;i++)l=.3*y[i]+.7*l;out=Array(h).fill(l)}if(method==='Holt'||method==='Holt-Winters'){let seasonal=method==='Holt-Winters';if(seasonal&&n<24)return null;let level=seasonal?avg(y.slice(0,12)):y[0],trend=seasonal?(avg(y.slice(12,24))-avg(y.slice(0,12)))/12:y[1]-y[0],s=seasonal?Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>y[i]-level):[];for(let i=seasonal?12:1;i<n;i++){let prev=level;level=.3*(y[i]-(seasonal?s[i%12]:0))+.7*(level+trend);trend=.1*(level-prev)+.9*trend;if(seasonal)s[i%12]=.2*(y[i]-level)+.8*s[i%12]}out=Array.from({length:h},(_,j)=>level+(j+1)*trend+(seasonal?s[(n+j)%12]:0))}if(method==='Linear Regression')out=regression(y,1,h);if(method==='Quadratic Regression')out=regression(y,2,h);if(method.includes('+ Seasonality')){let degree=method.startsWith('Quadratic')?2:1,idx=indices(y,degree),base=regression(y,degree,h);if(!idx||!base)return null;out=base.map((v,j)=>v*idx[(n+j)%12])}return out&&valid(out)?out.map(clamp):null}
function evaluate(y,method){let min=method.includes('Seasonality')||method==='Holt-Winters'?24:method==='Quadratic Regression'?8:6;if(y.length<min+3)return null;let actual=[],pred=[];let start=Math.max(min,y.length-12);for(let i=start;i<y.length;i++){let p=forecast(y.slice(0,i),method,1);if(p){actual.push(y[i]);pred.push(p[0])}}if(actual.length<3)return null;let abs=actual.map((v,i)=>Math.abs(v-pred[i])),nz=actual.map((v,i)=>[v,abs[i]]).filter(([v])=>v!==0);return{mae:avg(abs),mape:nz.length?avg(nz.map(([v,e])=>e/Math.abs(v)))*100:null,wape:actual.reduce((s,v)=>s+Math.abs(v),0)>0?abs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/actual.reduce((s,v)=>s+Math.abs(v),0)*100:null}}
function numeric(v){if(typeof v==='number')return Number.isFinite(v)?v:0;if(v==null||v==='')return 0;let s=String(v).trim().replace(/\s/g,'');if(s.includes(',')&&s.includes('.'))s=s.lastIndexOf(',')>s.lastIndexOf('.')?s.replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.'):s.replace(/,/g,'');else if(s.includes(','))s=s.replace(',','.');let n=Number(s);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0}function readRows(wb){let sheet=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]],arr=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet,{header:1,defval:''});let hi=arr.findIndex(r=>r.some(c=>/^(COD|CODE|SKU|ΚΩΔ)/i.test(String(c).trim())));if(hi<0)throw Error('Could not find a header row containing COD, CODE or SKU.');let headers=arr[hi].map(x=>String(x).trim());let match=re=>headers.findIndex(h=>re.test(h));let ci=match(/^(COD|CODE|SKU|ΚΩΔ)/i),di=match(/^(DESCRIPTION|PRODUCT|ΕΙΔΟΣ|ΠΕΡΙΓ)/i),si=match(/^(STOCK|CURRENT STOCK|ΑΠΟΘΕΜΑ)/i),ei=match(/^(EXPECTED SKU|EXPECTED|INCOMING)/i),ri=match(/^(RESERVED SKU|RESERVED)/i);let sales=headers.map((h,i)=>({h,i,m:(h.match(/^-?\s*(\d+)\s*MONTH/i)||h.match(/^SALES\s*[-_ ]?\s*(\d+)/i))})).filter(o=>o.m).map(o=>({...o,offset:Number(o.m[1])})).filter(o=>o.offset>0).sort((a,b)=>b.offset-a.offset);if(sales.length<12)throw Error('At least 12 monthly sales columns are required, e.g. -1 MONTHS SALES through -12 MONTHS SALES.');return arr.slice(hi+1).filter(r=>r[ci]!==''&&r[ci]!=null).slice(0,15).map(r=>({code:String(r[ci]),desc:di>=0?String(r[di]):'',stock:si>=0?numeric(r[si]):0,expected:ei>=0?numeric(r[ei]):0,reserved:ri>=0?numeric(r[ri]):0,history:sales.map(s=>numeric(r[s.i]))})).filter(r=>r.history.length>=12)}
function analyse(items,h){return items.map(item=>{let tests=METHODS.map(method=>({method,metrics:evaluate(item.history,method)})).filter(x=>x.metrics);let eligible=tests.filter(x=>x.metrics.mape!=null);let rank=(eligible.length?eligible:tests).sort((a,b)=>((a.metrics.mape??a.metrics.wape??Infinity)-(b.metrics.mape??b.metrics.wape??Infinity)));let best=rank[0]?.method||'Moving Average';let preds=forecast(item.history,best,h)||Array(h).fill(avg(item.history.slice(-3)));let comparison=METHODS.map(method=>({method,metrics:evaluate(item.history,method),pred:forecast(item.history,method,h)}));let total=preds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);return {...item,best,preds,total,order:Math.max(0,Math.ceil(total-item.stock-item.expected+item.reserved)),comparison,metrics:rank[0]?.metrics||{},season:indices(item.history,1)}})}
function fmt(v,d=1){return v==null||!Number.isFinite(v)?'N/A':v.toLocaleString('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:d,minimumFractionDigits:d})}function render(){let h=Number($('horizon').value);$('results').classList.remove('hidden');$('count').textContent=output.length;$('period').textContent=h;$('rows').innerHTML=output.map(o=>`<tr><td>${esc(o.code)}</td><td>${esc(o.desc)}</td><td><span class="best">${esc(o.best)}</span></td><td>${fmt(o.metrics.mape)}%</td><td>${fmt(o.metrics.wape)}%</td><td>${fmt(o.total)}</td><td>${fmt(o.order,0)}</td></tr>`).join('');$('comparisonRows').innerHTML=output.flatMap(o=>o.comparison.map(c=>`<tr><td>${esc(o.code)}</td><td>${c.method===o.best?'<span class="best">'+esc(c.method)+' ✓</span>':esc(c.method)}</td><td>${fmt(c.metrics?.mae)}</td><td>${fmt(c.metrics?.mape)}%</td><td>${fmt(c.metrics?.wape)}%</td><td>${fmt(c.pred?.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0))}</td></tr>`)).join('');$('product').innerHTML=output.map((o,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${esc(o.code+' — '+o.desc)}</option>`).join('');$('seasonHead').innerHTML='<th>Product</th>'+Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>'<th>Cycle '+(i+1)+'</th>').join('');$('seasonRows').innerHTML=output.map(o=>'<tr><td>'+esc(o.code)+'</td>'+(o.season?o.season.map(v=>'<td>'+fmt(v,2)+'</td>').join(''):'<td colspan="12">Seasonality requires 24+ months of sales</td>')+'</tr>').join('');draw()};function esc(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function draw(){
let o=output[Number($('product').value)||0];if(!o)return;
let c=$('chart'),dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1,w=c.clientWidth||800,height=390;
c.width=w*dpr;c.height=height*dpr;
let g=c.getContext('2d');g.scale(dpr,dpr);g.clearRect(0,0,w,height);
let hist=o.history,forecast=o.preds,all=[...hist,...forecast],max=Math.max(1,...all)*1.15;
let margin={l:65,r:22,t:57,b:56},pw=w-margin.l-margin.r,ph=height-margin.t-margin.b;
let x=i=>margin.l+pw*i/Math.max(1,all.length-1),y=v=>margin.t+ph*(1-v/max);
g.font='13px Inter,Arial';g.textBaseline='middle';g.strokeStyle='#e2e8f0';g.fillStyle='#475569';
for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){let val=max*i/4,yy=y(val);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(margin.l,yy);g.lineTo(w-margin.r,yy);g.stroke();g.fillText(fmt(val,0),7,yy)}
let boundary=x(hist.length-1);g.save();g.setLineDash([4,5]);g.strokeStyle='#94a3b8';g.lineWidth=1.5;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(boundary,margin.t);g.lineTo(boundary,margin.t+ph);g.stroke();g.restore();
g.fillStyle='#334155';g.font='bold 13px Inter,Arial';g.fillText('Actual Sales',margin.l,18);g.fillStyle='#f97316';g.fillText('Forecast',margin.l+125,18);
g.font='12px Inter,Arial';g.fillStyle='#64748b';g.fillText('Forecast starts →',Math.min(boundary+8,w-132),margin.t+13);
function line(vals,start,color,dashed){g.beginPath();g.strokeStyle=color;g.lineWidth=3;g.lineJoin='round';g.setLineDash(dashed?[8,5]:[]);vals.forEach((v,i)=>{let xx=x(start+i),yy=y(v);i?g.lineTo(xx,yy):g.moveTo(xx,yy)});g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);vals.forEach((v,i)=>{g.beginPath();g.arc(x(start+i),y(v),3.2,0,2*Math.PI);g.fillStyle='#fff';g.fill();g.strokeStyle=color;g.lineWidth=1.7;g.stroke()})}
line(hist,0,'#2563eb',false);line([hist.at(-1),...forecast],hist.length-1,'#f97316',true);
let step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(all.length/(w<600?7:12)));
g.fillStyle='#475569';g.font='12px Inter,Arial';g.textAlign='center';
for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++){if(i%step!==0&&i!==hist.length-1&&i!==all.length-1)continue;let label=i<hist.length?'M-'+(hist.length-1-i):'F+'+(i-hist.length+1);g.fillText(label,x(i),height-34)}
g.font='12px Inter,Arial';g.fillStyle='#64748b';g.fillText('Historical months (M-) | Forecast months (F+)',w/2,height-12);g.textAlign='start';
}
$('product').addEventListener('change',draw);window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(output.length)draw()});$('run').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let f=$('file').files[0];if(!f){$('status').textContent='Please select an Excel or CSV file first.';$('status').className='status error';return}if(!window.XLSX){$('status').textContent='Excel library unavailable. Check your internet connection.';$('status').className='status error';return}let btn=$('run');btn.disabled=true;$('status').className='status';$('status').textContent='Reading file and comparing models…';try{let data=await f.arrayBuffer(),wb=XLSX.read(data,{type:'array'}),items=readRows(wb);if(!items.length)throw Error('No product rows found.');output=analyse(items,Number($('horizon').value));render();$('status').textContent='Analysis complete. '+output.length+' product(s) analysed locally in your browser.'}catch(e){$('status').textContent=e.message;$('status').className='status error'}finally{btn.disabled=false}});$('sample').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!window.XLSX){alert('Excel library unavailable.');return}let header=['COD','Description','STOCK','EXPECTED SKU','RESERVED SKU',...Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>'-'+(i+1)+' MONTHS SALES')],rows=[header];for(let p=1;p<=3;p++)rows.push(['SKU-00'+p,'Sample product '+p,100,20,5,...Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>Math.round((90+p*40)*(1+.25*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*i/12))+(11-i)*1.1))]);let wb=XLSX.utils.book_new();XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(rows),'Sales');XLSX.writeFile(wb,'TiedChain_Forecasting_Sample.xlsx')});$('export').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!output.length)return;let wb=XLSX.utils.book_new(),res=[['Product Code','Description','Best Method','MAPE %','WAPE %','Forecast Total','Current Stock','Expected','Reserved','Order Proposal',...Array.from({length:Number($('horizon').value)},(_,i)=>'Forecast Month '+(i+1))]];output.forEach(o=>res.push([o.code,o.desc,o.best,o.metrics.mape??'',o.metrics.wape??'',o.total,o.stock,o.expected,o.reserved,o.order,...o.preds]));XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(res),'FORECAST RESULTS');let cmp=[['Product Code','Description','Method','MAE','MAPE %','WAPE %','Forecast Total','Best Method']];output.forEach(o=>o.comparison.forEach(c=>cmp.push([o.code,o.desc,c.method,c.metrics?.mae??'',c.metrics?.mape??'',c.metrics?.wape??'',c.pred?.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)??'',c.method===o.best?'YES':''])));XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(cmp),'MODEL COMPARISON');let sea=[['Product Code','Description',...Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>'Cycle Month '+(i+1))]];output.forEach(o=>sea.push([o.code,o.desc,...(o.season||Array(12).fill(''))]));XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(sea),'SEASONALITY ANALYSIS');XLSX.writeFile(wb,'TiedChain_Forecasting_Results.xlsx')});
